prompt_text: Best donor CRM for food security organizations
response_text:
For **food security organizations**, the strongest donor CRM depends on whether you need a **food-bank-specific platform** or a broader nonprofit CRM. Based on the results you provided, **StratusLIVE** appears to be the most directly positioned option for food banks, while **Humanitru** and **GoFundMe Pro/Classy** are also specifically recommended in food-bank fundraising contexts.[1][5]

If you want the shortest practical answer:

- **Best food-security-specific pick:** **StratusLIVE** for food banks, because it is presented as a trusted CRM built for food banks and nonprofit workflows.[1]
- **Best fundraising-focused option:** **GoFundMe Pro (formerly Classy)**, because it is described as providing polished, conversion-optimized donation pages used by major hunger-relief organizations.[5]
- **Best broader donor-management options:** **DonorPerfect** and **Bloomerang**, which are repeatedly listed among top nonprofit CRMs and are commonly used for donor tracking and retention.[4][7][2]

A simple way to choose:

| Need | Best fit from results | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Food bank / pantry operations | **StratusLIVE** | Most explicitly tailored to food banks.[1] |
| Strong online fundraising pages | **GoFundMe Pro / Classy** | Focus on conversion-optimized donation pages.[5] |
| General donor CRM for nonprofits | **DonorPerfect** | Feature-rich donor tracking, reporting, and nonprofit discounts.[4][7] |
| Donor retention and relationship management | **Bloomerang** | Frequently highlighted for donor retention.[3][7] |

If you are a **small food pantry or local hunger-relief nonprofit**, the results also suggest **LiveImpact** as a strong all-in-one value option, while **Little Green Light** is highlighted for lower cost in small-nonprofit use cases.[3]
